findings: Effect studio first viewport is consumed by cue display timing and parameter controls; media preview is not continuously visible while editing.
Cue start/end inputs expose excessively long floating point seconds (e.g., 40.48533333333333).
Long, read-only source and translated text take substantial vertical space; repeated scrolling disconnects controls from visual effect.
Preview and Inspector coexist, but dense bilingual rendered text takes most of the visual stage; poor space for legibility evaluation.
Inspector controls dominate height and contain repeated similarly weighted operations; editing text can be far from the preview.
Horizontal/tablet composition should prioritize stage, adjust inspector width, and preserve artifact/preview status near its action.

supported_root_causes: After page reload refresh() read /api/status once and renderJobs(s.jobs), but never reattached watchJob(ongoing.id); a frozen page-visible progress value does not by itself demonstrate backend FFmpeg halted.

ArchiveBundleExporter invoked Popen with stdout=PIPE and stderr=PIPE, drained stdout to EOF before reading stderr; a full stderr pipe can block FFmpeg. This is a real possibility, not proven to be the exact device freeze cause.
Time input rendering used String(raw_float), exposing binary timeline fractions without formatting.
